jobs.title: SAGE Teamlead
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

For our Visp Integrated Biologics and Specialized Modality organizations, we are seeking an Automation Lead to manage programs that strengthen operational capability and standardization, and contribute to recipe management efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and manage a team of Automation Engineers, ensuring team functionality and alignment with operational priorities.

• Deliver on direct line management responsibilities, including mentoring, performance feedback, and development planning.

• Collaborate with Operations, MSAT, and Quality across business platforms to align automation objectives with business strategy.

• Coordinate schedules and deliverables, to meet the needs of Integrated Biologics and Specialized Modality operations while managing team capacity effectively.

• Manage a local Center of Excellence for MES and DCS Automation, working with the global Center of Excellence to standardize automation approaches in biopharma manufacturing.

• Act as an integrator—removing barriers, ensuring consistent communication, and building alignment between global strategy and site operations.

• Contribute automation expertise to design development teams.

• Provide high-level troubleshooting support with the team.

• Act as a subject matter expert in DeltaV and Syncade systems, GMP lifecycle management, and biological manufacturing

• Manage compliance tasks related to multi-asset SOP assessments and CAPAs and ensure timely closure.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biochemistry, or related fields, or equivalent experience.

• Experience: 5+ years in Biologics GMP manufacturing with operational experience and strong knowledge of MES/DeltaV systems.

• Technical Skills: Advanced knowledge of DeltaV, MES and GMP manufacturing principles and  compliance in automation.

• Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead teams, get results, and promote collaboration across departments.

• Discernment and savvy in understanding the business landscape, along with a strong customer orientation and the ability to collaborate effectively.

• Language Skills: Proficient in English (required); German proficiency is a plus.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Line Mechanic (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Location. Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

Your tasks:

• Repairing or replacing malfunctioning components, parts, and other mechanical or electrical equipment in the clean room and sterile environment (experience with aseptic filling lines is preferrable)

• Performing functional tests to validate the effectiveness of repair work. Maintaining records of maintenance services and repairs

• Executes manufacturing activities in the area of Drug Product according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Eliminating faults in the systems

• Open and track malfunction reports

• Continuous improvements

• Cooperate, advice and support Plant Engineering department

• Coordination of work processes in consultation with the team leaders

• Advanced handling of SAP, Cornerstone, DMS, Office 365

Your profile:

• You have completed an EFZ apprenticeship as a mechanic or related profession (production mechanic, car mechanic, etc.)

• Several years of experience as a mechanic is an advantage

• Excellent interpretation of P&ID diagrams or drawings

• Very good knowledge of German is essential, English is an advantage

• Independent and precise way of working

• You are customer-oriented and open to new ideas

• Communication skills, initiative and resilience round off your profile.

• Willing to work in 3-Shifts pattern.

jobs.title: Logistik-Spezialist Versand 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir mehrere Logistik-Spezialisten für den Bereich Versand & Cold Chain.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Durchführung der Versand-Aktivitäten sowie Bearbeitung der Direktanlieferungen

• Koordination & Durchführung temperaturkontrollierter Transporte

• Verwenden von validierten Verpackungssystemen sowie Überwachung der Temperaturdaten (Logger, Monitoring)

• Dokumentation aller Temperatur- und Versanddaten gemäss regulatorischen Vorgaben.

• Analyse und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Versandprozesse.

• Bestandskontrolle und Datenpflege im ERP-System sowie Durchführung von Inventuren.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Vorgaben im gesamten Logistikbereich.

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene logistische Ausbildung (bevorzugt Logistikfachmann-/frau oder CPT) mit eidg. Fähigkeitsausweis

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 3 Jahre) in der Pharma-Logistik oder einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in GDP/GMP, Gefahrgutversand (IATA, ADR) und Cold Chain Handling

• Praktische Erfahrung mit SAP EWM / WM / MM

• Analytische Fähigkeiten zur Prozessoptimierung und Datenanalyse

• Kommunikationsstärke, Organisationstalent, Belastbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Staplerausweis und Erfahrung mit Flurförderfahrzeugen

jobs.title: Internship QA Compliance 6 months contract 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stücki, Switzerland.

For our successful Drug Product (DP) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Internship QA Compliance position.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:
Support the QA Compliance team for Lonza DPS Basel and Stein related to quality systems, training, audits, authority inspections, supplier qualification and quality agreement management.
Specifically the role will focus on:

• Customer audit scheduling

• Preparation of project-specific documentation

• Supporting quality metrics and data analytics activities

• Contributing to ongoing QA Compliance projects, including system implementation and maintenance

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor, Master or PhD degree in life sciences or pharmaceutical sciences

• Quality focused and optimization mindset

• Experienced in data handling and visualization

• Strong analytical abilities and good communication/presentation skills

• Prior exposure to cGMP practices and pharmaceutical industry experience preferred

• Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English and German required

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Analytical Project lead Commercial QC 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and manage pharmaceutical projects of drug entities within commercial QC from various customers which are in late clinical development or commercial. This includes authoring and reviewing complex GMP documents and advanced project documents (e.g. specifications, protocols, reports, APQR)

• Ensure the successful and timely delivery of QC work packages for assigned projects. This includes on-time close out/authorization and provision of documents and reports (e.g. transfer, validation, batch release, stability), LIMS specifications, lead of change requests, CAPAs, investigation of deviation and OOX events. Independently and proactively address risks and resolve issues of deliverables on time for mitigation, including good communication to all stakeholders

• Responsible for end-to-end completion of sample lifecycle for assigned projects from sampling to disposal including material reconciliation in collaboration with Lab Support Team and Sample Management Team. This includes processing of associated documents and proactive management of risks/issues.

• Acts as a single point of contact for assigned projects within commercial QC.

• Represents commercial QC in Lonza internal project meetings and customer meetings for complex topics as SME (Subject Matter Expert).

• Effectively networks and liaise with partner units and relevant stakeholders within the Lonza network to ensure the successful delivery of projects.

• Reviews and approves assay documentation under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) in a right first time and timely manner.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of analytical method capabilities for assigned projects to support the definition of potential Critical Quality Attributes and the analytical control strategy

What we are looking for:

• MSc in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field

• Experience in Analytics or Quality Control under cGMP regulations

• Proven project management success

• Knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical lifecycle for biotechnology products and CMC requirements

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proactive attitude

• Detail-oriented and able to work in a matrix organization

• Business fluent English, written and spoken

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Join our dedicated team at Lonza in Visp and become part of a group of hardworking professionals at the forefront of life sciences. As a DSP Process Expert (m/f/d), you will play a key role in delivering cutting-edge solutions in Visp, Switzerland. This role offers the chance to work in a world-class environment where your contributions will have a lasting impact on the future of medicine.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available.

What you will do:

• Leading cross functional teams as a process expert tasked with technology transfers (process design and scale-up) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale. This includes the whole lifecycle of assigned projects from planning, implementation, control to completion in alignment with defined project goals.

• Serve as the key interface between the process donor (customer or process development) and operations, to ensure scalability and suitability of the manufacturing processes for commercial-scale production.

• Securing success during technology transfer by applying procedures and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control.

• Responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing, considering all regulatory and GMP requirements.

• Responsible for execution of risk analyses for the manufacturing processes under GMP.

• Interacting directly with customers and stakeholders during tech transfer, campaign preparation, execution and closure, including daily reporting of batch status and performance.

• Ensuring timely compilation of process related deviations, change requests and campaign reports.

• Compiling CMC sections and technical content of validation reports

• Develop and implement standardized MSAT procedures and processes.

• Driving continuous improvements of the manufacturing processes.

• Evaluating and driving innovative trends within the respective area of expertise.

What we are looking for:

• Master's degree, PhD or equivalent experience is a plus

• Preferred area of study:  Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related subject areas

• More than 5 years of experience in DSP for the manufacture of APIs or process development

• Deep understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice of APIs

• Strong scientific and technical acumen

• Fluency in English and German

• Strong leadership skills

• Very good communication to interact with various stakeholders

• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude

• Open-minded personality with strong interest to learn and grow

• Agility and high motivation

• A strong problem-solving mindset

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Head of Global Marketing
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

At Lonza, we are looking for a Head of Global Marketing to lead and transform the company’s global marketing strategy across all business platforms. This role is responsible for shaping Lonza’s global brand positioning, strengthening commercial storytelling, and driving integrated, insight-driven marketing programs that support growth, customer engagement, and market leadership across the CDMO industry.

In this highly visible leadership position, you will oversee the full global marketing ecosystem, including strategic marketing, branding, digital marketing, marketing operations, analytics, campaigns, and commercial excellence. You will partner closely with Business Platforms, Sales, Communications, and Group Intelligence teams to deliver consistent and differentiated customer engagement strategies while driving operational excellence and digital marketing maturity across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and deploy Lonza’s global marketing strategy across all business platforms, ensuring alignment with commercial priorities and growth objectives

• Lead segmentation, value proposition development, messaging architecture, and customer-centric marketing strategies across the CDMO portfolio

• Partner closely with Business Platforms to align marketing activities with portfolio priorities, product lifecycles, and customer needs

• Translate market intelligence and customer insights into differentiated commercial narratives and go-to-market strategies

• Co-own and steward the Lonza global brand, ensuring consistent positioning, governance, and application across all channels and regions

• Strengthen Lonza’s reputation and visibility through compelling brand storytelling, executive communications, and customer-facing content

• Lead the global marketing operations function, including campaign governance, budgeting, KPI management, reporting, and operational standardization

• Drive digital marketing strategy across demand generation, SEO/SEM, paid media, social media, account-based marketing, and digital customer engagement initiatives

• Partner with IT and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance marketing systems, MarTech capabilities, analytics, and digital maturity across the organization

• Lead commercial enablement initiatives by developing customer-facing materials, sales tools, and insight-driven commercial storytelling frameworks

• Establish robust analytics, dashboards, and KPI frameworks to measure marketing effectiveness, ROI, pipeline contribution, and operational performance

• Develop and lead a high-performing global marketing organization, fostering collaboration, capability building, and continuous improvement across teams

Required Qualifications:

• Extensive senior marketing leadership experience within life sciences, pharma, biotech, CDMO, or other complex B2B industries

• Proven track record leading global marketing organizations, strategic transformations, and integrated marketing initiatives at scale

• Strong expertise across multiple marketing disciplines including strategic marketing, branding, digital marketing, marketing operations, and commercial excellence

• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate customer and market insights into impactful growth strategies

• Deep understanding of brand stewardship, value proposition development, and customer-centric marketing approaches

• Strong digital marketing expertise with experience in MarTech ecosystems, marketing automation, analytics, and digital engagement strategies

• Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across complex, matrixed organizations

• Proven ability to build, coach, and develop high-performing global teams

• Strong operational discipline with experience standardizing processes, governance models, and scalable ways of working

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc, life sciences, or related field) preferred

• Fluency in English required

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Technisches Praktikum ab 50% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die MINTworld ist eine gemeinsame Initiative der Lonza AG in Visp und des Kanton Wallis. Auf einer Fläche von rund 1000 m² bietet sie Kindern und Jugendlichen sowohl während der Schulzeit als auch in ihrer Freizeit die Möglichkeit, die vielfältigen Fachbereiche der MINT-Disziplinen (Mathematik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften und Technik) praxisnah zu entdecken. Kompatibel mit dem Lehrplan 21, können so Theorie und Praxis auf eine spielerische und spannende Art verknüpft werden. Mehr Infos findest du unter www.mintworld.ch.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Entwicklung und Konzeption neuer Workshops in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team

• Unterstützung bei der Ausarbeitung und Erweiterung des Angebots

• Unterstützung der Kursleiter*innen bei der Organisation und Durchführung verschiedener MINT-Workshops

• Selbstständige Leitung von Workshops

• Je nach Qualifikation Möglichkeit zur Durchführung unterstützender Forschungstätigkeiten in einem modernen Industrielabor (z. B. HPLC, GC, Titration, Zellkultivierung, Fermentation, Versuchsanlagen, Laborautomation)

Was wir suchen:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Matura in einem MINT-relevanten Bereich oder laufendes Studium an einer Fachhochschule oder Universität im MINT-Bereich

• Alternativ auch Interessenten mit pädagogischer oder lehramtlicher Ausbildung, im Studium oder in Planung eines solchen Studiums

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Labortätigkeiten, CNC, 3D-Druck, Elektronik oder Informatik

• Interesse an aktiver Weiterentwicklung sowie die Suche nach einem Unternehmen, das Raum für das Einbringen und Umsetzen kreativer Ideen bietet

• Teamfähigkeit sowie selbstständiges und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten.

• Motivation zur Zusammenarbeit mit jungen Menschen in einem pädagogischen und multikulturellen Umfeld

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

jobs.title: QC Lab Technician II VibeX (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

• Durchführung und Freigabe von physikalisch-chemischer Analysen (z.B. TOC, Nitratanalyse, pH, Leitfähigkeit) unter Einhaltung der cGMP Richtlinien.

• Review der Laborresultate.

• Durchführung von Studien für die Reinigungsvalidierung für den gesamten Standort.

• Instandhaltung bestehender Infrastrukturen.

Anforderungsprofil:

• Sie haben eine abgeschlossene(s) Ausbildung und/oder idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in Labor.

• Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit dem PC und Standardsoftware.

• Eine gewissenhafte, saubere und detail-orientierte Arbeitsweise zeichnen Sie aus.

• Sie sprechen fliessend Deutsch und idealerweise auch sehr gut Englisch.

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Scientist QC (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
 Key responsibilities:

• Consulting operations regarding cleaning validation analytics for existing projects, NPI and growth projects.

• Responsibility for the organization of cleaning studies in QC.

• Setup QC plans in LIMS for cleaning validation and cleaning samples .

• Review of analyses for cleaning samples.

• Participation in and responsibility for audits and inspections.

Key requirements:

• Completed studies in natural sciences (BSc/MSc//PhD) or a comparable qualification.

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry in the field of cleaning validation is an advantage.

• GMP experience is an advantage.

• You enjoy taking on challenges in a dynamic environment.

• You have a very good understanding of German and English.

• On-call duty every 3 - 4 months (assignments are carried out remotely).

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: (Senior-) Program Manager, Advanced Synthesis 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of

The Visp site in Switzerland is growing rapidly, driven by our Advanced Synthesis Business Platform, which includes Bioconjugates and Small Molecules. Our teams specialize in developing and manufacturing drug substances under GMP, helping bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.

We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Advanced Synthesis organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.

• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.

• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.

• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.

• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.

• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.

• Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and organizational factors.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex programs.

• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing and drug substance development.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: VI Operator (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

What you will do:

• Execute manual visual inspection

• Executes manufacturing activities in the area of Drug Product according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution.

• Provides front line technical and procedural support, working with the manufacturing team.

• Securing each batch is manufactured safely, on time, in compliance with the batch instructions and quality requirements

• Responsible for establishing timely and with high quality the required production documentation (preparation, execution and review of batch records) or other relevant GMP documents for the assigned production area.

• Supports process related investigations and assists in decision making on production issues

• Supports process changes and CAPAs related to processes within required timelines

• Performs training activities of relevant areas as operator and supports others and new joiners.

• Operating, setting up and cleaning production equipment and premises for the production of liquid and freeze-dried drug forms (e.g.:compounding, parts washing, autoclaving, filter integrity testing, visual inspection)

What we are looking for:

• 2-4 years of experience GMP environment on the shopfloor (preferably in sterile manufacturing of Drug Product)

• Fluent in either English or German (preferably both)

• Familiarity with GMP requirements, quality procedures and SOP execution

• Strong team orientation

• Effective communication skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization

• Structured, focused, and well-organized working attitude

• High motivation and dynamic drive

• IT knowledge and knowledge in SAP and MES is a benefit

• Prepared to work in 2 shifts pattern

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead

titleByLocale.it: Senior Direttore, Programme Management & Governance Lead
titleByLocale.en: Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead
titleByLocale.de: Senior Direktor, Programme Management & Governance Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Directeur, Programme Management & Governance Lead

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

At Lonza, we are looking for a Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead to lead the governance, orchestration, and delivery assurance of the Global Lonza Capability Centre (LCC) transformation programme. This highly visible leadership role will be instrumental in shaping the future of Lonza’s global service delivery model, ensuring the successful execution of a complex, multi-function transformation spanning multiple geographies and delivery waves. Partnering closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and transformation teams, you will drive alignment, governance excellence, and value realization while enabling sustainable operational scalability and long-term business growth.

Key responsibilities:

• Lead the end-to-end orchestration of the Global Lonza Capability Centre transformation programme, ensuring alignment across all workstreams, delivery waves, and strategic objectives

• Act as the central integration point across design, technology, workforce, transition, and operational readiness activities to ensure successful programme execution

• Provide strategic direction and subject matter expertise in Global Business Services and Capability Centre design, challenging assumptions and guiding decision-making based on industry-leading practices

• Develop and maintain the integrated master programme roadmap, actively managing interdependencies, risks, timelines, and deliverables across all programme teams

• Design and implement the programme governance framework, including steering committees, executive forums, toll-gate reviews, decision rights, and escalation processes

• Ensure programme quality, readiness, and governance standards are consistently applied across all phases of the transformation lifecycle

• Oversee integrated wave planning and validate readiness across infrastructure, technology, workforce, transition, and service delivery activities prior to go-live

• Partner closely with transformation leaders, implementation teams, and business stakeholders to proactively identify and resolve programme risks, bottlenecks, and execution challenges

• Drive programme performance management through robust RAID processes, dependency tracking, financial oversight, and executive reporting mechanisms

• Monitor budget consumption, scope management, and value realization, ensuring execution remains aligned with the approved business case and strategic objectives

• Act as the primary interface between the programme, executive leadership, and the Transformation Office, providing clear, fact-based communication and decision support

• Lead external consulting partners, service providers, and programme vendors to ensure high-quality deliverables and successful programme outcomes

• Promote continuous improvement by embedding lessons learned, strengthening governance practices, and enhancing programme execution capabilities across subsequent transformation waves

Requires qualifications:

• Extensive and proven experience leading Global Business Services (GBS), Shared Services, Global Capability Centres (GCC), or large-scale enterprise transformation programmes in complex multinational organizations, preferably Swiss headquartered

• Proven track record establishing and scaling Global Capability Centres, preferably in India, and delivering large-scale operating model transformations

• Deep expertise in programme governance, PMO leadership, executive steering, and the successful delivery of complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes

• Strong understanding of GBS and GCC operating models, including service management, transition management, governance, value realization, and business case delivery

• Experience leading technology-enabled transformations involving organizational design, workforce transitions, service migrations, and enterprise platforms such as SAP S/4HANA

• Strong knowledge of India’s capability centre ecosystem, including talent dynamics, regulatory considerations, and operational setup requirements

• Experience operating within highly regulated industries, preferably life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or CDMO environments

• Broad business understanding across functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Marketing, and Master Data Management

• Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior executives, global teams, and external partners around a common transformation agenda

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required; PMP (or equivalent certification) preferred.

• Fluency in English is required, German desirable

• Willingness to travel globally (30%+) is expected

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

For our successful and growing Drug Product focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Senior Scientist Process Development Drug Product 12 months contract position.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you’ll do:

• Assist establishment of Drug Product process development infrastructure and services for parenteral drug products for clinical and commercial use

• Install, qualify, and maintain equipment for process development, non-GMP manufacturing and related analytics in close alignment with current best practices and regulations

• Plan and perform process development and characterization studies for liquid and lyophilized parenteral drug products of biologics (e.g. monoclonal antibodies, novel formats, ADCs, peptides), peptides and small molecules

• Supervision of the junior scientists or interns when required

• Document data following applicable lab procedures and current documentation practices

• Good understanding on Annex1 and the implication on GMP Drug product manufacturing process (e.g. Filtration, Mixing and Compounding, Hold-time, Ambient light, VHP uptake)

• Support manufacture of non-clinical and clinical drug supplies at GMP sites

What we’re looking for:

• Science or engineering degree (BSC or MSc) in a relevant discipline, e.g. Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical or Biochemical Engineering

• Minimum 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical or chemical industry, preferably in process development

• Working experience in relevant pharmaceutical development and manufacturing technologies. Experience with parenteral dosage forms, protein formulation and analytics and aseptic working techniques is a plus

• Very good knowledge of reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results

• Experience with parenteral dosage forms and/or lyophilization techniques is a plus

• Ability to work independently in a team environment, with attention to detail and proactive attitude. Good knowledge of written and spoken English. Any other languages are a plus

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Review and approve physico-chemical QC analytical data packages (e.g., identity, purity, content, compendial tests) under cGMP, ensuring compliance with SOPs and Good Documentation Practices

• Ensure timely tracking and closure of internal and external QC testing activities; escalate risks or delays proactively

• Coordinate sample lifecycle activities (from pull to disposal) and manage associated documentation in collaboration with QC Project Lead and laboratory teams

• Support investigations of deviations, OOX events, and CAPAs related to QC testing

• Contribute to onsite customer or regulatory audits by providing QC-related documentation and clarifications

What we are looking for:

• MSc or BSc in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field

• 0–4 years of experience in QC or analytical development; prior exposure to GMP environments is advantageous

• Basic understanding of physico-chemical analytical techniques (e.g., HPLC, CE/icIEF, protein content, pH, osmolality)

• Familiarity with laboratory systems such as LIMS, Empower, or Electronic Lab Notebooks is a plus

• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work within established procedures

• Effective communication and collaboration skills; business fluent English (written and spoken)

jobs.title: Pipe Fitter / Metalworker 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

For our site in Visp, we are currently seeking several qualified Pipe Fitters / Metalworkers.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available.

Your Responsibilities:

• Professionally and cost-effectively measure, fabricate, and install complex piping systems and support structures in industrial piping construction

• Prepare isometric drawings and piping spool assemblies in accordance with technical specifications and project requirements

• Plan and organize work processes based on P&ID flow diagrams for project work and plant modifications

• Apply PED directives and work according to internal piping classes, plant standards, and quality assurance requirements

Your Profile:

• Completed vocational training as a technician specializing in piping construction, pipefitting, heating installation, or plumbing installation.

• Several years of professional experience as a pipefitter or piping preparator/fabricator is an advantage

• Willingness to pursue continuous professional development

• Enjoy working across departments and capable of working independently and flexibly within a team

• Reliable, resilient, entrepreneurial mindset, with open and direct communication skills

• Good command of German, both written and spoken; English skills are an advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Shift Teamlead Downstream Production
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Coordinate and support DSP production activities across Chromatography, Viral Inactivation/Filtration, UFDF, Formulation, and Final Fill to ensure timely and compliant execution.

• Serve as the key interface between production, support functions, and operational stakeholders to enable smooth day-to-day operations.

• Lead workforce planning for DSP production support, including shift coverage, overtime management, and short- or long-term personnel reallocations.

• Optimize staffing levels by balancing operational efficiency, GMP compliance, and employee well-being.

• Own training needs analysis and ensure implementation of qualification and training plans aligned with GMP, safety, and operational requirements.

• Drive performance management, employee development, and succession planning while fostering a collaborative and high-accountability team culture.

• Manage recruitment and onboarding of DSP production personnel in partnership with HR to ensure sustainable team capability and retention.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in large-scale DSP production (8+ years).

• This position operates on a 4‑shift model; therefore, willingness—and preferably prior experience—working in such a shift pattern is required.

• Proven hands-on experience in large-scale biotechnological manufacturing environments.

• Strong experience working in GMP-regulated manufacturing settings.

• Very good command of English (written and spoken) for operational leadership and cross-functional collaboration; German is an advantage.

• Solid understanding of business processes and production-related operational workflows.

• Demonstrated leadership capability with strong people management, communication, and team-oriented skills.

• Structured, well-organized, and solution-oriented working style with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive continuous improvement.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: QA Expert, Manufacturing Release 60%

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di QA, rilascio di fabbricazione 60%

jobs.description:
The location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Drug Product Services team in Stein, Switzerland – a leading CDMO branch shaping the future of patient treatment. As a Quality Assurance Expert Manufacturing Release, you’ll play a key role in the release of drug product from our aseptic fill&finish lines, ensuring product quality requirements are met while providing rigorous oversight from technical transfer, manufacturing and release. Be part of a team that drives excellence and innovation in global healthcare! This is an ideal opportunity for people who wish to work parttime 60%.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here:  https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Perform batch release for aseptic manufactured drug product

• Write, review and approve deliverables (e.g. procedures, SOPs, risk assessments, gap assessments) and related data bases (e.g. training, validation) to ensure GMP compliance

• Review and approve documents  in both electronic systems (e.g. MES) and paper-based. Approve change requests, deviation and CAPAs related to product and process

• Promote and enforce compliance to internal and external guidelines regarding quality and safety

• Ensure required level of knowledge and skills as well as identify competency gaps and solutions. Lead development and evaluation of new tools, processes, quality initiatives & plans

• Be present at the manufacturing line to watch and support with manufacturing-related activities

• Support projects and maintain Sterile Production Stein line functions in GMP compliance related issues

What we are looking for:

• Degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in Natural Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field

• Work experience in sterile drug product manufacturing OR sterile drug substance manufacturing in a GMP controlled environment

• Experience in deviation and change management is a prerequisite

• Work experience in QA is an advantage

• Hands on personality, you openly approach business partners, excellent influencing and negotiation skills

• Fluency in English is required, German language skills are an advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
R76585 - Senior Program Manager Microbial – 80 - 100% (m/f/d)

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and we are currently looking for (Senior) Program Managers for our Microbial BU. In this role, you will be the Key interface between Sales and Operations in order to deliver and execute customer contracts. You are an advisor along the whole life cycle and will propose the optimal package to successfully deliver the drug to the patients together with the project team.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

• A dynamic and collaborative work environment in a growing global company

• The opportunity to lead impactful programs in cutting-edge microbial manufacturing

• Career development and training tailored to your goals

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• A workplace that values integrity, sustainability, and innovation

• The satisfaction of making a meaningful difference in people’s lives

What you will do:

• Lead the full lifecycle of complex programs from contract signature to delivery

• Act as the single point of contact for customers and advocate for their needs on-site

• Manage cross-functional project teams in a matrix environment

• Ensure delivery on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards

• Communicate proactively with internal and external stakeholders to manage risks and resolve issues

• Support scope changes and amendments in collaboration with Sales and Proposals teams

• Coach and mentor team members to foster growth and collaboration

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biotechnology, biology, or a related field; PhD preferred

• Proven multi-year experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO environments

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex programs with multiple stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Project Delivery Visp (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Location: Visp

What you will get:

• A key role shaping our Global Engineering Functions

• Collaboration with a dynamic team in an innovative environment.

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

The Senior Manager - Process Automation Lead drives process automation strategy, governance, and recipe development activities at project level within Global Engineering, ensuring automation solutions are aligned with manufacturing and process requirements. The role serves as the primary interface between MSAT, Manufacturing, Engineering, CQV, and Automation departments, translating process intent into structured automation deliverables that enable safe, compliant, scalable, and reproducible operations.

As a member of the Global Engineering Delivery organization, the Process Automation Lead leads a team of specialists and external resources responsible for process automation definition, recipe design, and digital innovation initiatives supporting both capital projects and legacy assets. The role ensures standardization of automation methodologies, lifecycle management of process automation deliverables, and implementation of digital solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, and operational excellence.

What you will do:

• Lead the process automation function at project level, focusing on process automation strategy, recipe development, and integration of process requirements into automation solutions.

• Define, govern, and drive process automation scope for capital growth projects and selected legacy asset improvement initiatives.

• Serve as the primary interface between Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, CQV, and Automation teams to ensure alignment of process requirements and automation implementation.

• Lead the development and standardization of process automation deliverables, including functional diagrams, functional specifications, parameter tables, operating concepts, and process control strategies.

• Own and continuously improve process automation standards, methodologies, templates, and best practices across Global Engineering projects.

• Drive digitalization initiatives within process automation, including AI-enabled recipe parametrization tools, automation troubleshooting solutions, structured specification generation, and other digital innovation programs.

• Lead, mentor, and coordinate a project team of consultants, and external contractors supporting process automation activities.

• Support FATs, SATs, commissioning, qualification, startup, and troubleshooting activities, ensuring alignment between process requirements and automation execution.

What we are looking for:

• BSc or MSc in Sciences or related field

• Demonstrate strong technical leadership in process automation and recipe-based manufacturing systems

• Strong expertise in process control concepts, batch automation, and recipe management methodologies

• Ability to translate complex process requirements into structured automation specifications and technical documentation

• Strong knowledge of DeltaV and modern DCS platforms from a requirements and process perspective

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured and data-driven approach

• Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority

• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across Engineering, Manufacturing, MSAT, and Automation organizations

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Senior Laborant Feststoffe 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Location. Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Am Standort Visp wird im Bereich Pharma (Advanced Synthesis) ein/e erfahrene/r Laborant/in (m/w/d) mit Feststoffexpertise gesucht. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborexperimenten im Feststoffbereich zuständig. Im Weiteren sind Sie für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung des Feststofflabors zuständig und stehen Kollegen bei Experimenten beratend zur Seite. Zusammen mit Sachbearbeitern vertreten Sie den Feststoffbereich in Projektteams im Bereich Entwicklung, Optimierung und Troubleshooting.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborexperimenten im Bereich Kristallisation, Filtration, Trocknung, Mahlen, Sieben und Feststoffcharakterisierung

• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung vom Feststofflabor sowie Unterhalt der Geräte

• Fachtechnische Laborverantwortung und Ansprechpartner für feststoffspezifische Fragestellung bei Laborexperimenten

• Aus- und Weiterbildung von Lehrlingen & Praktikanten

• Mitarbeit in Projekten bei feststoffspezifischen Fragestellungen und Unterstützung der Forschungs- und Entwicklungsgruppen, sowie der Produktionsbetriebe

Was wir suchen:

• Laborant EFZ (Chemie) oder vergleichbar

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Feststoffbereich

• Fliessend Deutsch ist notwendig, zusätzliche Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Teamfähigkeit

• Freude an der interdisziplinären Arbeit

• Vernetztes Denken

• Kreatives, lösungsorientiertes Handeln

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.
Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben!

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Am Standort Visp wird im Bereich Pharma (Advanced Synthesis) ein/e erfahrene/r Laborant/in (m/w/d) mit Feststoffexpertise gesucht. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborexperimenten im Feststoffbereich zuständig. Im Weiteren sind Sie für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung des Feststofflabors zuständig und stehen Kollegen bei Experimenten beratend zur Seite. Zusammen mit Sachbearbeitern vertreten Sie den Feststoffbereich in Projektteams im Bereich Entwicklung, Optimierung und Troubleshooting. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld
• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen. Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie unten:
• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Ihre Aufgaben:
• Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborexperimenten im Bereich Kristallisation, Filtration, Trocknung, Mahlen, Sieben und Feststoffcharakterisierung
• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung vom Feststofflabor sowie Unterhalt der Geräte
• Fachtechnische Laborverantwortung und Ansprechpartner für feststoffspezifische Fragestellung bei Laborexperimenten
• Aus- und Weiterbildung von Lehrlingen & Praktikanten
• Mitarbeit in Projekten bei feststoffspezifischen Fragestellungen und Unterstützung der Forschungs- und Entwicklungsgruppen, sowie der Produktionsbetriebe Was wir suchen:
• Laborant EFZ (Chemie) oder vergleichbar
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Feststoffbereich
• Fliessend Deutsch ist notwendig, zusätzliche Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Teamfähigkeit
• Freude an der interdisziplinären Arbeit
• Vernetztes Denken
• Kreatives, lösungsorientiertes Handeln Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben! Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician Quality Control 80-100%
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Als Mitglied der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) sind sie verantwortlich für die praktische Durchführung eines breiten Spektrums von biologischen und biochemischen Methoden zur Charakterisierung von komplexen und hoch aktiven konjugierten Antikörperwirkstoffen (aber auch anderer Biomoleküle) unter ISO und GMP. Bei den Biokonjugaten handelt es sich um eine innovative Klasse an Wirkstoffen, in die u.a. in der Krebstherapie grosse Hoffnungen gesetzt werden.
Das ELISA Team arbeitet vorwiegend mit Bioconjugaten und gehört zur Abteilung QC-Biologics. Die QC-Biologics ist in die übergeordnete QC-Organisation am Standort Visp mit mehr als 400 Mitarbeitern integriert.

Aufgaben:

• Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung, Transfer und Validierung sowie der Routineanalytik von biologischen und biochemischen Methoden im ELISA Team (ELISA, Dot Blots und biochemischer Gehaltsbestimmungen)

• Durchführung der Methoden unter ISO- bzw. GMP-Bedingungen

• Aktive Mitarbeit an Untersuchungen durchgefallener Assays unter Anleitung mit Troubleshooting

• Kontrolle und Freigabe von Hilfsprotokollen anderer Teammitglieder

• Wartung und Kalibrierung von Laborgeräten

• Mitarbeit an der Erstellung GMP relevanter Dokumente

Ihr Augenmerk liegt bei ihrer Tätigkeit auf der sicheren und qualitätskonformen Bearbeitung der zugewiesenen Aufträge. Sie sind selbstständig im Rahmen von Studien und Projekten tätig und übernehmen Verantwortung für deren Erfolg.
Sehr gerne werden auch Lehrabgänger für diese Position berücksichtigt.

Qualifikationen:

• Sie haben eine passende Berufslehre (Biologielaborant/in oder vergleichbar) abgeschlossen

• Idealerweise haben sie  schon grundlegende Erfahrungen im GMP-Umfeld, bevorzugt in einem analytischen Labor, gesammelt

• Es macht Ihnen Spass, sich auf die wechselnden Herausforderungen der Projekte einzulassen und Ihre Umsetzung im Labor flexibel, eigenverantwortlich und sorgfältig anzugehen

• Neben Deutsch besitzen Sie sich auch grundlegende Englischkenntnisse (mindestens Leseverständnis)

• Eine flexible Persönlichkeit, Teamgeist,  Eigeninitiative, Lern- und Einsatzbereitschaft runden Ihr Profil ab

Was Sie erwartet:

Treten Sie Lonza bei und vereinen Sie das Beste zweier Welten. Sie bekommen die Gelegenheit, mit inspirierenden Kolleginnen und Kollegen an einem führenden wissenschaftlichen und technologischen Standort zu arbeiten. Dabei können Sie einen besonderen Lebensstil geniessen und das Zuhause mitten in den Alpen Ihr Eigen nennen.
Jetzt ist eine spannende Zeit, um unserem Lonza-Team in Visp beizutreten. Seit langem waren und sind wir ein Kompetenzzentrum in der Herstellung von chemischen und pharmazeutischen Produkten für die globalen Pharma- und Chemiemärkte. Der Start des Ibex™ Konzepts ist auch der Start eines neuen Kapitels der Lonza-Geschichte.
Im Wallis werden Sie alles finden, was sie für eine erfüllende Karriere und ein lebenswertes Leben brauchen.

Hier erhalten Sie einen ersten Eindruck unseres Standortes Visp: Lonza in Visp

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
